title: Neuroscience and Buddhism, Mind and Brain
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett suggests that our traditional views of the mind and brain as separate entities or as solely rational systems may be limiting, and instead proposes exploring alternative perspectives that recognize the intricate interdependence between consciousness and the physical body. By acknowledging the unique value and complexity of consciousness, we can move beyond simplistic notions of logic and emotion to understand how our brains actually work and how they relate to our overall well-being. This new understanding can help us live in greater harmony with ourselves and the world around us, and find fulfillment by aligning with our deeper inner selves.
